parameters.meaning: destruction probability of weapon platform/interceptor i against target k
tracking probability of sensor platform j against target k
cost of launching/using interceptor or weapon platform i
cost of activating sensor platform j
overall storage of interceptors / total ammunition baseline

variables.meaning: 1 if weapon platform/interceptor i is assigned to target k; 0 otherwise
1 if sensor platform j tracks target k; 0 otherwise

derived.meaning: destruction probability of target k from assigned weapons
tracking probability of target k from assigned sensors
number of interceptors used in the current round

objective.formula: - sum_k v_k * P_k * Q_k / sum_k v_k
objective.meaning: negative normalized threat elimination efficiency; minimizing O1 maximizes elimination

objective.formula: (sum_k sum_j c_j_S*y_jk + sum_k sum_i c_i_W*x_ik) / (sum_j c_j_S + sum_i c_i_W or source normalization)

objective.meaning: interceptor consumption, equivalent to preserving reserved strength

constraints.formula: sum_i x_ik >= 2 for each target k
constraints.meaning: each target must be assigned at least two weapons/interceptors

constraints.formula: sum_j y_jk >= 1 for each target k
constraints.meaning: each target must be tracked by at least one sensor

constraints.formula: sum_k x_ik <= 1 for each weapon platform/interceptor i
constraints.meaning: each weapon/interceptor can be assigned to at most one target in the round

constraints.formula: sum_k y_jk <= sensor_capacity_j, typically at most one unless data provide a larger capacity

equivalence_rules: The first objective may be written as maximizing threat elimination or minimizing its negative, if objective direction is explicit.
Reserved strength must remain tied to interceptor consumption / remaining ammunition, not generic risk/load concentration.
A weighted sum is not the gold formulation; the gold formulation is a three-objective vector.
algorithm_boundary: POMBDE, differential evolution mapping, Pareto-optimal matching and heuristic initialization are solution algorithms, not formulation constraints
public_private_boundary: All planted assignments, bandwidth plans, Pareto/deployment answers, path response traces and algorithm populations are private validation only unless explicitly defined as exogenous public scenario data.
